# libopus

libopus 1.5.2 (https://opus-codec.org), the sources `sources.txt` lists (from `celt/`, `silk/`, `src/`) and `include/`,
unmodified, as NotRexed copied them from TOTKPort into Hookshot. BSD 3-clause: `COPYING`. `nx2/build.py` builds them into
the game for nn::codec's hardware Opus decoder (`host/nn_codec.c`), with `PACKAGE_VERSION` "opus-1.5.2".
